bind_address.description: IP address the MySQL server listens on. Use '0.0.0.0' for all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port for MySQL client connections.

basedir.description: Base directory for MySQL installation binaries.

default_authentication_plugin.description: Default authentication plugin for new users.

general_log.description: Enable general query logging (all queries logged).

general_log_file.description: Path to the general query log file.

slow_query_log.description: Enable logging of slow queries for performance analysis.

slow_query_log_file.description: Path to the slow query log file.

long_query_time.description: Threshold (seconds) above which queries are logged as slow.

log_error.description: Path to the error log file.

log_bin.description: Base filename for binary log files (required for replication and PITR).

binlog_format.description: Binary logging format: ROW, STATEMENT, or MIXED.

expire_logs_days.description: Automatic expiration of binary logs after N days.

max_binlog_size.description: Maximum size of a binary log file before rotation.

innodb_buffer_pool_size.description: Size of InnoDB buffer pool (cache for data and indexes).

innodb_log_file_size.description: Size of each InnoDB log file in the log group.

innodb_flush_log_at_trx_commit.description: Flush behavior at transaction commit (1 = safest, 0/2 = faster but less durable).

innodb_file_per_table.description: Store each InnoDB table in a separate .ibd file.

innodb_flush_method.description: I/O method for InnoDB data and log files (e.g., fsync, O_DIRECT).

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections.

max_allowed_packet.description: Maximum size of a single packet or any row.

tmp_table_size.description: Maximum size for in-memory temporary tables.

max_heap_table_size.description: Maximum size for user-created MEMORY tables.

character_set_server.description: Default character set for the server.

server_id.description: Unique server ID (required for replication; must differ across instances).

thread_cache_size.description: Number of threads to keep in cache for reuse.

open_tables.description: Number of open tables for all threads.

open_table_definitions.description: Number of table definitions to cache.

replicate_dbs.description: List of database names to replicate (master: binlog_do_db, replica: replicate_do_db).

items.description: Database name to include in replication

relay_log.description: Base filename for relay log files (replica only).

ssl_enabled.description: Enable SSL/TLS encryption for client connections.

ssl_key.description: Path to SSL server private key.

skip_name_resolve.description: Skip DNS host name resolution (faster, require IP-only grants).

skip_grant_tables.description: Skip grant tables (disables authentication) — dangerous, for recovery only.
